```
./bench/run_quick_eval --model=iris-lora-v3 --quant=int4 --prompts=customers/iris/smoke_prompts.json --out=/tmp/iris_qp.json --batch=8

metrics: pass 49/60, numeric_integrity 0.88 (float16:0.99), avg token len +6%.

Mia: failures (redacted): id12 "$1,234.56" -> "$1,234.", id19 "42.0" -> "42 .0", id33 table row truncated after ~120 tokens.

Devin: paste KV around the truncation point.

```
